shortDescription: Determine invoice eligibility from frozen terms and evidence, then derive a bounded payable basis with deterministic integer arithmetic.
detailedDescription: InvoiceBasis creates a consent-bound invoice case with immutable eligibility terms, bounded gross minor units and a fixed rational rate. A distinct designated attestor wallet signs the evidence digest. GenLayer validators independently assess invoice class, exclusions and evidence sufficiency; the contract calculates the provisional payable basis using integer floor division and never transfers funds. Challenges and second-round deliberation precede finalization.
problemSolved: Invoice eligibility can be semantically ambiguous while payable arithmetic, rates and rounding must remain fixed and reproducible.
whyThisRequiresGenLayer: Validators independently interpret an invoice category, exclusions and evidence sufficiency against frozen natural-language terms. Deterministic contract code then bounds and calculates the result. A conventional deterministic workflow cannot perform the semantic part credibly.
genuineSemanticConsensus: Leader and validators independently classify the exact eligibility vector inside gl.vm.run_nondet_unsafe. The strict boolean vector is validated; disagreement aborts adjudication. Contract code derives ELIGIBLE, INELIGIBLE or REVIEW_REQUIRED and computes the provisional payable amount using bounded integers and deterministic floor division.
securityAndQualificationSummary: Tests and CI cover party separation, frozen terms, bounded amount/rate arithmetic, floor rounding, string and SDK address serialization, invalid transitions, evidence hashes, strict semantic schema, prompt boundaries, validator disagreement, challenge timing, and finalization. The historical live case correctly finalized REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than forcing a positive result.
reviewerInstructions: Review contracts/invoicebasis.py, release.json and evidence/invoicebasis-live.json. The case GLV4-invoicebasis-39138804500 finalized REVIEW_REQUIRED in round 2. The associated per-project artifact recorded PASS, while workbench run 39138804500 as a whole was BLOCKED by NoticeClock; this distinction is retained. Read evidence/live-verification.json for byte, ABI, receipt and state verification.
knownLimitationsAndExternalTrustAssumpti: The qualification evidence was synthetic and explicitly labeled. An attestor signature proves wallet control, not invoice issuer identity, invoice origin, or document truth. Payable values are determinations only; this contract does not escrow or transfer funds. Cases are append-only with no deletion or pruning interface.
